nyfed_recession_probability.source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, 'The Yield Curve as a Leading Indicator': probability of a US recession twelve months ahead, estimated from the 10-year minus 3-month spread
nyfed_recession_probability.note: The Fed's probit model reads the July 2026 average spread (+0.78) and assigns the probability of an NBER-dated recession by July 2027. They publish monthly as a legacy .xls workbook; the value is hand-entered here with tools/nyfed-check.py as the ritual, deliberately not scraped, and the page shows staleness once last_reviewed is more than 45 days old.
